blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: Identity: Campbell Valley is a rural sub-area of the Township of Langley, in south Langley around Campbell Valley Regional Park, close to the U.S. border, and a named FVREB sub-area of the Langley community — it is not a municipality. The guide page states the boundary caution itself: the MLS® "Campbell Valley" sub-area and local usage differ, so a listing's placement must be checked.
Where condo stock concentrates: nowhere. No Campbell Valley median, $/sqft, sale-to-list or DOM is published, and none is estimated.
Nearby areas as the guide states them: Brookswood and South Langley generally to the north, Hazelmere / South Surrey to the west, and the U.S. border to the south.

Anchor: Campbell Valley Regional Park is a Metro Vancouver regional park — forests, fields and wetlands, trails for walkers, cyclists and horseback riders, and a Nature House; the park is run by Metro Vancouver, not the Township.
Catchment for a specific Campbell Valley address: Not confirmed — no SD35 locator run for a Campbell Valley address is on record.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Campbell Valley Guide

items.t: ALR stratification bar — leads this section, because guide-feed copy raises strata ideas: ALR residences cannot be stratified. Depositing a strata plan causes subdivision in the ALR and needs ALC permission — ALC Information Bulletin 09, s.6; see also Strata Property Act s.239 and Agricultural Land Commission Act s.21(1).

ALC residence caps (for parcels in the ALR): one principal residence at a maximum total floor area of 500 m² (no more than 1,000 m² of fill); a secondary suite only within the principal residence; at most one additional residence of up to 90 m² (40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha); local bylaws may be more restrictive, not more permissive. The guide page's ALR section states the same 500 m² / 90 m² frame.
Township zoning and OCP frame: A specific parcel's zoning, permitted dwellings and barns are not confirmed at parcel level; Township confirmation is required for the specific parcel.

Township SSMUH — the correct rule: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 6020, adopted November 18, 2024 — 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less, 4 units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m², lots over 4,050 m² ineligible, and NO 6-plex tier exists in the Township. Most Campbell Valley acreage parcels exceed the 4,050 m² ceiling by a wide margin, so the SSMUH framing generally does not apply to them; eligibility for a specific parcel is not confirmed.
Suites and coach houses (Township): The "15% of lot to max 100 m²" coach/garden-suite rule is Abbotsford's, NOT the Township's, and is not applied here.

BC Assessment farm-class thresholds (for farmed parcels): $2,500 (0.8–4 ha); $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha (over 4 ha); $10,000 (under 0.8 ha); applications by October 31, and a buyer continuing to farm must apply by October 31 after purchase. A flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR. The farm-class position of Campbell Valley's stock as a group is not confirmed — classification is property-by-property.

Form B (BC standard block): Strata Property Act s. 59 — a strata must provide a Form B Information Certificate within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page, with the most recent depreciation report attached.

Depreciation reports / CRF: depreciation report every 5 years for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023. Rentals / age: rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (flag every directory "rentals not allowed" line void in-entry — no such line arises in this sub-area's verified stock, because there is none); only 55+ age bylaws legal (SPA ss.123.1/123.2, Reg 7.01, with exemptions including the May 1, 2023 expansion).

Pad rent (parks): where a Campbell Valley purchase involves a manufactured-home pad, pad rent is governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act, not the Strata Property Act: the rent increase limit is 2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026 and 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027, with 3 full months' notice and one increase per 12 months.

Fee-simple acreage parcels

items.t: A Campbell Valley parcel is fee-simple unless title shows otherwise — no strata, no Form B, no strata fees on the parcel itself; Township zoning, ALR status (where applicable) and registered charges govern. As of September 2026, Source: SnapStats.

Lot character, only: the feed mixes large acreages (a 4.38-acre equestrian property, an 8.99-acre property, a 9.92-acre Land card in card text) with small-lot product (a 0.312-acre property in card text) under the same sub-area label. Card zoning labels (RU1 and RU-3 in listing text) are listing copy only; a specific parcel's zoning, permitted dwellings and barns are not verified at parcel level and are confirmed with the Township per parcel.

items.t: What the page covers: the Campbell Valley area / homes page, headed "Campbell Valley Homes for Sale | South Langley Real Estate," with a short editorial introduction, no FAQ and no feed-count header in the text read, above a listing feed. It is not the same page as campbell-valley-acreages-farms-for-sale, the separate topic feed page.

The cards read are all labelled Campbell Valley, Langley, all Status: Active, Residential except one Land card, and they include a 4.38-acre equestrian property, a 0.312-acre RU1-zoned property stated in its card to be outside the ALR, a 2.32-acre estate, an 8.99-acre RU-3 property per its card, and a 9.92-acre Land card — the feed mixes large acreages with small-lot product inside the same sub-area label.

Campbell Valley Regional Park: Metro Vancouver's park page describes forests, fields and wetlands providing habitat for wildlife, with walkers, cyclists and horseback riders able to explore the network of trails, and a Nature House.

Market numbers (sub-area row + community context only — land/farms have NO SnapStats category): Campbell Valley's own figures, September 2026 — Detached inventory 16 / sold 0 / sales ratio NA; Condos & Townhomes inventory 0 / sold 0 / sales ratio NA. As of September 2026, Source: SnapStats.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Campbell Valley

items.t: Township zoning: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw 1987 No. 2500 governs this ground. Feed cards use RU1 and RU-3 labels in their own listing text — card labels are listing copy only, and a specific parcel's zone is confirmed with the Township per parcel.

SSMUH as the Township states it: Bylaw 6020, adopted November 18, 2024 — 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less, 4 units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m², lots over 4,050 m² ineligible, and no 6-unit tier. Most Campbell Valley acreage parcels exceed the 4,050 m² ceiling by a wide margin, so the SSMUH framing generally does not apply to them; parcel-level eligibility is not verified. Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 had first/second reading May 25, 2026 ONLY — never state that they "replaced" Bylaw 6020; the Willoughby Plan is Bylaw 1836, now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200.

Suites / coach houses (Township): secondary suite cap 120 m². R-CL s.403 (220 m² minimum lot / 464.5 m² maximum LOT area — no 355 m² figure exists) is a Willoughby compact-lot rule, carried here only as part of the Township frame, not as a Campbell Valley rule.

ALR block (for parcels that are in the ALR): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m² (no more than 1,000 m² of fill), suite within the principal residence only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); local bylaws may be more restrictive and may not be more permissive.

: $2,500 of farm income if the operation is 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area in excess of 4 ha if the operation is greater than 4 ha; $10,000 if the operation is less than 0.8 ha. A flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR wherever met.

Strata diligence (the BC strata block — applies in full to any bare-land strata lot, if one is met): Form B diligence (fees, amounts owed, levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions; a listing's "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

Township property taxes: Township property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026; a penalty of 5% is applied to current-year taxes, including the unclaimed home owner grant, at midnight July 2, 2026, and an additional 5% at midnight September 3, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about Campbell Valley

items.t: A board sub-area label is not a farm, ALR or park-adjacency statement: the same Campbell Valley label covers a 9.92-acre Land card and a 0.312-acre small-lot card stated to be outside the ALR — parcel status is a separate check for every card.

Campbell Valley's zero combinations are not unique to Campbell Valley: Otter District is also Condos & Townhomes 0 / 0 (Detached 2 / 0), and County Line Glen Valley is Detached 0 inventory with 1 sale — the detached-only shelf is a rural-Langley pattern. As of September 2026, Source: SnapStats.

R-CL's numbers belong to Willoughby, not to this valley: s.403's 220 m² minimum / 464.5 m² maximum lot area is a compact-lot rule from another Township neighbourhood — importing it into a Campbell Valley acreage valuation is an error, and no 355 m² figure exists in that section at all.

No per-acre price exists in the permitted sources: SnapStats has no farm or acreage category and no official source opened publishes per-acre or equestrian-property prices for Campbell Valley — any such figure is not verified.

faq.q: Are Campbell Valley's zero figures unique among Langley sub-areas?

faq.a: Under the ALC frame: one principal residence of 500 m² or less (no more than 1,000 m² of fill), a secondary suite only within the principal residence, and at most one additional residence of up to 90 m² on properties 40 ha or less or up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha, with local government rules possibly more restrictive; whether a specific parcel is in the ALR is not confirmed, so check the ALC map and the Township for the exact parcel.

faq.a: Neither, on the usual Campbell Valley parcel: Township Bylaw 6020 makes lots over 4,050 m² ineligible and has no 6-unit tier at all; parcel-level eligibility is not confirmed.
